# The door impersonator

One planted escape, laid out to match the pin's OLD exemption on every axis it
checked: a file path ending `combat/combatant.go`, an import path of
`.../rulebooks/dnd5e/combat`, and a declaration named `GetEffectiveAC`.

It is a METHOD, and the real door is a package-level function. That is the only
difference, and under the old rule it was not a difference at all — the
impersonator widened members and the pin passed.

`TestTheDoorCannotBeImpersonated` requires it caught. Never built; `testdata` is
invisible to the go tool.
